question: A chart's vertical axis starts at 90 instead of zero, exaggerating a small fall in a KPI. This violates:
option_a: Automatic refresh scheduling
option_b: Row-level security
option_c: The naming convention of the report
option_d: Honest data storytelling, because axis truncation can mislead viewers about the magnitude of change
explanation: Truncated axes distort proportions, so honest visuals keep scales and baselines transparent.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: Data storytelling in a dashboard means:
option_a: Adding as much text as possible to every visual
option_b: Structuring data, visuals and narrative so that findings and recommended actions are clear to the audience
option_c: Replacing all charts with paragraphs
option_d: Removing all annotations from visuals
explanation: Storytelling unifies evidence and narrative to drive decisions.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: Conditional formatting in a Power BI visual is used to:
option_a: Change the font of the title manually once
option_b: Rename a column permanently
option_c: Colour values automatically based on rules (e.g., red when a KPI falls below target)
option_d: Rebuild the data model each week
explanation: Rules-based colouring draws attention to outliers and thresholds.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: Row-level security (RLS) in Power BI protects data by:
option_a: Restricting which rows different users can view, based on defined roles and DAX expressions
option_b: Disabling all visuals for non-finance users
option_c: Encrypting the visual colours
option_d: Blocking external report refresh permanently
explanation: RLS filters data by user roles so each viewer sees only the authorised rows.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: A report with hundreds of complex visuals runs slowly. The most effective performance fix is:
option_a: Add even more visuals to the same page
option_b: Import wider tables with duplicate columns
option_c: Simplify to fewer, well-modelled visuals and measures, reduce rows, and avoid heavy per-row calculations
option_d: Disable relationships to save memory
explanation: Model and visual efficiency, not more hardware, usually determines report speed.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: To share a completed dashboard with stakeholders who do not have Power BI Desktop, the standard route is:
option_a: Publish the report to Power BI Service and share it with the intended workspace or audience
option_b: Send the .pbix file by group email
option_c: Screenshot every visual into Word
option_d: Print all pages as PDFs
explanation: The Service enables controlled sharing, live refresh and governance.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: An 'auto refresh' schedule in Power BI Service affects:
option_a: The colour scheme of the visuals
option_b: The names of the report pages
option_c: The security of user passwords
option_d: When the data sources are re-imported through the gateway to update the dashboard data
explanation: Scheduled refresh keeps published dashboards current from the configured data sources.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: For a Chief Statistician's dashboard, KPIs should be arranged so that:
option_a: Only the most detailed tables are shown
option_b: Top-level indicators appear first, drilling down to the underlying detailed indicators when needed
option_c: Every KPI is equally prominent with no hierarchy
option_d: No indicator is connected to any target
explanation: The hierarchy mirrors management focus: headline outcomes first, then their drivers.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: A State Statistical Bureau wants a monthly executive dashboard on survey operations. A recommended design starts with:
option_a: A single enormous table of all raw records
option_b: Only decorative charts with static labels
option_c: KPIs such as response rate, coverage and timelines with trend lines, plus drill-downs to districts and stages
option_d: No filters because executives dislike them
explanation: Operational KPIs with drill-down give executives both a status snapshot and a diagnosis capability.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: Which measure computes the year-to-date total of a KPI within the current date context?
option_a: TOTALYTD(SUM(Scheme[amount]), 'Calendar'[Date])
option_b: TOTALMONTH(SUM(Scheme[amount]))
option_c: DATEDIFF(SUM(Scheme[amount]), 'Calendar'[Date])
option_d: CALCULATE(SUM(Scheme[amount]), 'Calendar'[Year])
explanation: TOTALYTD computes the cumulative total from the start of the year to the latest date in context.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: Drill-down in a hierarchy visual (Year -> Quarter -> Month) allows a user to:
option_a: Open a separate database for each level
option_b: Switch between active connections
option_c: Filter by only the first data row
option_d: Move from summary levels to successively detailed levels within the same visual
explanation: Hierarchies enable progressive disclosure of detail on demand.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: A 'drillthrough' page in Power BI is designed to:
option_a: Print the main page in landscape
option_b: Show focused detail about a selected record or measure when a user clicks from a main page
option_c: Change the login credentials
option_d: Add new columns to the model
explanation: Drillthrough pages present context-specific detail from a selection point.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: An analyst must compare the quarterly growth of six socio-economic indicators consistently. The best single visual approach is:
option_a: Six pie charts of the quarterly totals
option_b: A table of raw quarterly values only
option_c: A set of small-multiple line charts on a shared axis so the patterns are directly comparable
option_d: One scatterplot with the six indicator names encoded as colour
explanation: Small multiples control for axis differences and make patterns across indicators directly comparable.

course_name: Executive Dashboard Development in Power BI
question: To ensure all ministries report the same definition of 'expenditure covered', a dashboard strategy includes:
option_a: A certified data model with shared measure definitions, used as a single governed dataset by all reports
option_b: Every team building its own copy with different measures
option_c: Publishing conflicting figures intentionally
option_d: Discarding shared definitions annually
explanation: Certified, governed datasets provide one version of the truth across dashboards.
